planetary_targets.name: Shackleton Crater Rim (Artemis III South Pole)
planetary_targets.key_process: Cryogenic volatile trapping in Permanently Shadowed Regions (PSRs) & hyper-low angle solar illumination

planetary_targets.name: Marius Hills Skylight Pit (Lunar Mare Lava Tube)
agency_sources: NASA LRO LROC NAC (Sub-meter Pit Geometry)
JAXA SELENE / Kaguya Lunar Radar Sounder
planetary_targets.key_process: Volcanic lava tube roof collapse (skylight formation) & subsurface thermal radiation shielding

planetary_targets.name: Malapert Mountain (Peak of Eternal Light & Artemis Relay)
planetary_targets.key_process: Near-continuous solar illumination (86% diurnal cycle) & continuous direct line-of-sight to Earth for permanent communications relay

planetary_targets.name: Aristarchus Pyroclastic Plateau (Volcanic Glass & ISRU)
planetary_targets.key_process: Explosive lunar pyroclastic volcanism depositing regional high-titanium orange/black volcanic glass beads enriched in trapped solar-wind hydrogen and volatiles

target_specs.dominant_rock: Regional Pyroclastic Volcanic Glass & High-Ti Basalt

planetary_targets.name: Jezero Crater Western Delta & Floor
planetary_targets.key_process: Fluvial-lacustrine deltaic sedimentation, hydrothermal carbonate alteration & aeolian TAR migration

planetary_targets.name: Arcadia Planitia (Human Mars Landing Candidate)
agency_sources: TES Thermal Inertia (Bedrock vs. Fine Regolith)
planetary_targets.key_process: Periglacial cryoturbation over shallow massive water-ice sheets (Starship ISRU candidate)

planetary_targets.name: Gale Crater & Mount Sharp Stratigraphy
agency_sources: NASA MSL Curiosity APXS & CheMin XRD
planetary_targets.key_process: Transition from ancient Noachian lacustrine habitable smectite clays to desiccating Hesperian sulfate salts and active aeolian Bagnold dune fields

target_specs.dominant_rock: Stratified Lacustrine Mudstone, Smectite Clay & Magnesium Sulfate

planetary_targets.name: Mawrth Vallis Ancient Clay Outflow Channel
planetary_targets.key_process: Ancient catastrophic mega-flood carving exposing 200m+ thick continuous sequence of diverse phyllosilicates (nontronite, montmorillonite, kaolinite) preserving Noachian biosignatures

earth_analogs.name: Rogaland Anorthosite Massif (Block B2)
earth_analogs.bbox_scale: 1.2 km × 1.2 km Glacially Polished Bedrock Grid
agency_datasets_used: ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 SWIR Plagioclase Index
JAXA G-Portal ALOS AW3D30 Slope DEM

metrics.dominant_rock: High-Purity Calcic Plagioclase Anorthosite (ESA Lunar Highlands Simulant Host)

earth_analogs.strong_analogy: 98% Mineralogical & geotechnical twin of Lunar Highlands / Artemis III Shackleton Rim regolith. Glacially polished, unweathered calcic plagioclase matches LRO Diviner silicate signatures and serves as ESA's premier European lunar regolith simulant host.
earth_analogs.breakdown_limits: Nordic winter maritime climate, subaerial precipitation, and 1g gravity.
earth_analogs.process_twin: Plutonic cumulate crystallization and glacial bedrock scour.
earth_analogs.seasonal_process_note: Glacially scoured, unweathered plagioclase bedrock exposed post-snowmelt for high-albedo LRO Diviner spectral calibration.

earth_analogs.name: Lonar Crater NE Basaltic Ejecta Rim (Sector 1)
agency_datasets_used: CSA RADARSAT Constellation Mission (RCM) Dual-Pol SAR Backscatter
NASA Earthdata ASTER Thermal Infrared Emissivity

metrics.dominant_rock: Shocked Tholeiitic Flood Basalt Breccia & Maskelynite Glass

earth_analogs.strong_analogy: Only terrestrial hyper-velocity impact crater emplaced purely in flood basalt. Yields shocked basalt breccias and maskelynite glass identical to Apollo 11/12 lunar mare return samples.
earth_analogs.breakdown_limits: Post-monsoon seasonal vegetation and Earth atmospheric pressure.
earth_analogs.process_twin: Hyper-velocity basaltic impact shock metamorphism, maskelynite formation, and fluidized ejecta emplacement.
earth_analogs.seasonal_process_note: Minimum canopy cover exposes blocky basaltic impact ejecta for CSA RADARSAT & LRO Mini-RF circular polarization ratio (CPR) matching.

earth_analogs.name: Haughton Crater & Periglacial Polygon Basin

metrics.dominant_rock: Ice-Cemented Impact Breccia & Periglacial Permafrost Polygons

earth_analogs.strong_analogy: Premier terrestrial analog for Mars Arcadia Planitia cryogenic ground-ice sheets and Artemis polar cold traps. Demonstrates sorted patterned ground and permafrost wedge cracking.
earth_analogs.breakdown_limits: Remote arctic logistics, seasonal sea-ice restrictions, and polar bear safety protocols.
earth_analogs.process_twin: Periglacial cryoturbation, thermal contraction cracking, and ground ice segregation.
earth_analogs.seasonal_process_note: Active-layer freeze-thaw cryoturbation over shallow ground-ice table matching Mars Arcadia Planitia SHARAD radar reflectors.

earth_analogs.name: Dallol Hydrothermal Evaporite Delta (Sector 2)

metrics.dominant_rock: Hydrothermal Iron-Sulfate, Smectite Clays, Jarosite & Halite (pH < 1.5)

earth_analogs.strong_analogy: 98% geochemical fidelity to Noachian Mars Jezero Crater acid-sulfate hydrothermal systems. Hyper-acidic brine ponds precipitate jarosite, natroalunite, and iron oxyhydroxides.
earth_analogs.breakdown_limits: Toxic volcanic fumes (SO2, H2S) requiring respirators and corrosive salt crusts.
earth_analogs.process_twin: Volcanic degassing, subsurface hydrothermal circulation, and hyper-saline flash evaporation.
earth_analogs.seasonal_process_note: Active hydrothermal brine degassing, iron-sulfate mineral precipitation, and polyextremophile chemolithoautotrophy.

earth_analogs.name: Qaidam Basin Sulfate Yardangs & Aeolian Field
agency_datasets_used: NASA EMIT Mineral Dust Imaging Spectrometer

metrics.dominant_rock: Hydrous Iron/Magnesium Sulfates (Jarosite/Kieserite) & Aeolian Sand Sheets

earth_analogs.strong_analogy: World's largest high-altitude hyper-arid yardang field with bedded sulfate mineralogy mirroring Martian sulfate units (kieserite, gypsum, jarosite) mapped by MRO CRISM.
earth_analogs.breakdown_limits: High altitude hypoxia (2,800m) and severe winter blizzards.
earth_analogs.process_twin: Aeolian deflation, wind abrasion, and capillary evaporite formation.
earth_analogs.seasonal_process_note: Bidirectional wind-carved sulfate yardangs and transverse aeolian ridges (TARs) matching Martian Gale and Jezero craters.

earth_analogs.name: Harrat Khaybar — Umm Jirsan Skylight Lava Tube
agency_datasets_used: JAXA ALOS AW3D30 Volcanic Shield DEM

metrics.dominant_rock: Alkali Olivine Flood Basalt & Roof Collapse Breakdown Boulders

earth_analogs.strong_analogy: Premier terrestrial analog for Lunar Marius Hills Pit and Martian volcanic conduits. Features 1.5 km of intact basaltic tube ceiling, 3 vertical skylights, and breakdown ramps.
earth_analogs.breakdown_limits: Earth 1g gravity and organic bat guano accumulations in cave deeper recesses.
earth_analogs.process_twin: Lava tube inflation, thermal downcutting, roof crusting, and gravitational collapse.
earth_analogs.seasonal_process_note: Subterranean lava tube interior maintains stable thermal shielding and GNSS-denied geometry matching Lunar Marius Hills Pit.

earth_analogs.name: Atacama Yungay Hyper-Arid Core (Control Benchmark)
earth_analogs.strong_analogy: Classic gold-standard Mars analog used by NASA Viking, Phoenix, and Curiosity teams. Extreme hyper-aridity, perchlorate soil chemistry, and negligible biomass.
earth_analogs.breakdown_limits: Benchmark over-testing reduces novel discovery potential; lack of active permafrost or volcanism.
earth_analogs.process_twin: Atmospheric hyper-aridity, UV photochemistry, and aeolian deflation.
earth_analogs.seasonal_process_note: Hyper-arid UV photochemical perchlorate generation and wind deflation.

earth_analogs.name: Askja Caldera & Holuhraun Lava Fields
earth_analogs.bbox_scale: 3.0 km × 3.0 km High-Permeability Volcanic Sand Plain

metrics.dominant_rock: Porous Tholeiitic Basalt Pumice, Ash & Recent Flood Basalt

earth_analogs.strong_analogy: Historic Apollo lunar astronaut training ground (Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin). Barren basaltic desert devoid of vegetation replicates lunar mare tephra and rough lava flows.
earth_analogs.breakdown_limits: Sub-polar oceanic rainfall, subaerial wind erosion, and high surface permeability.
earth_analogs.process_twin: Caldera collapse, explosive basaltic tephra fallout, and fissure eruption pahoehoe basalt crusting.
earth_analogs.seasonal_process_note: Highland tracks thaw; barren basaltic sand sheets exposed under continuous daylight.

earth_analogs.name: Svalbard Bokfjorden & Sverrefjell Volcanic Complex
earth_analogs.bbox_scale: 2.0 km × 2.0 km Arctic Sub-Zero Basalt Complex

metrics.dominant_rock: Mantle Xenolith Basalt with Hydrothermal Carbonate Globules (ALH84001 Twin)

earth_analogs.strong_analogy: Host of NASA/ESA Arctic Mars Analog Svalbard Expeditions (AMASE). Contains the only terrestrial carbonate globules identical to those found in Martian meteorite ALH84001.
earth_analogs.breakdown_limits: Extreme polar bear hazards, maritime fog, and 4-month polar night.
earth_analogs.process_twin: Sub-glacial volcanism, mantle xenolith entrainment, and cryogenic hydrothermal carbonate crystallization.
earth_analogs.seasonal_process_note: Pack ice retreats; pristine permafrost basalt talus slopes accessible for biosignature drill testing.

earth_analogs.name: Mauna Loa HI-SEAS Lunar/Mars Habitat & Volcanic Ridge
earth_analogs.bbox_scale: 1.5 km × 1.5 km High-Altitude Basaltic Regolith Field

metrics.dominant_rock: Pahoehoe & Aa Basaltic Lava with Intact Feeder Tubes

earth_analogs.strong_analogy: NASA-funded HI-SEAS habitat host for long-duration crew analog isolation missions. Features unweathered basaltic tephra and accessible volcanic tubes matching lunar maria.
earth_analogs.breakdown_limits: High tropical atmospheric moisture (inversion layer breaks) and active volcanic gas plumes.
earth_analogs.process_twin: Effusive basaltic shield volcano lava layering and subterranean tube crystallization.
earth_analogs.seasonal_process_note: High solar insolation above cloud inversion layer; optimal for human-in-the-loop EVA simulations.
